Name: Happy Life of Krobus
Author: lingofgu
Description:
[center][size=6]﻿[/size]
[b][color=#FFDEAD]你是否觉得科罗布斯总是待在下水道很可怜？为什么它不能在夜晚或者下雨天出门呢？本mod对科罗布斯的日常行程和一些设定进行了修改：[/color]
[/b][b]Do you feel sorry that Krobus always stays in the sewers? Why can't he go out at night or on rainy days? This mod modifies Krobus' daily schedule and some settings:
[/b]
[size=6][font=Courier New][color=#DDAODD][b]******************[/b][/color][/font]
[/size]
[color=#FFDEAD]1）对下水道进行了装修，布置了一些家具，包括床。他早上9点前会在床上，不用担心，只要科罗布斯在下水道地图内，和他对话都可以购买商品[/color]
[size=3]Renovated the sewers with furniture including a bed. He will stay in bed before 9 AM. Don't worry - you can still purchase items by talking to him as long as he's within the sewer map.[/size]

[color=#FFDEAD]2）他可以在雨天和晚上出门，去海边或煤矿森林的下水道入口[/color]
[size=3]He can go out to the beach or Cindersap Forest sewer entrance during rainy days and nights.[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3]
[color=#FFDEAD]3）他可以参加月光水母节、夜市、里奇赛德村的冬28日节日（没有让他参加万灵节）[/color]
He can participate in the Moonlight Jellies Festival, Night Market, and Winter 28th festival in Ridgeside Village.

[color=#FFDEAD]4）增加了一个动画，让他和矮人交朋友，事件触发之后，他有时会去矿井看望矮人[/color]
Added an animation event where he befriends the Dwarf. After triggering this event, he will occasionally visit the mines to see the Dwarf.[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][color=#FFDEAD]5）为了避免影响科罗布斯的商店事业，新增了一个目录可以售卖所有科罗布斯商店的物品，目录在科罗布斯处购买（要是可以在他外出时，放一个箱子在下水道就好了。其中关键的步骤是需要判断NPC是否在地图内。可我找了好几个mod，似乎都需要使用C#来写。我的C#知识已经忘得差不多，写一个C#mod对我来说有点太复杂。如果有人知道如何简单地写出这个功能可以给我留言，谢谢！）[/color]
To avoid affecting Krobus' shop business, added a catalog that sells all items from Krobus' shop (purchased from Krobus). (I wish I could place a chest in the sewers when he's out. The key step requires checking if NPCs are within the map. I checked several mods and it seems this needs to be written in C#. I've mostly forgotten C# and writing a C# mod is too complicated for me. If anyone knows a simpler way to implement this feature, please leave me a message. Thanks!)[/size][list=1]
[size=3]﻿
[/size][/list][size=3][color=#FFDEAD]6）科罗布斯商店目录是我自己画的，我不太会画画，已经尽力了。[/color]
The Krobus Shop Catalog was drawn by myself. I'm not good at drawing but tried my best.[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][color=#FFDEAD]7）本mod带英语和汉语版本对话，其中英语版是用DeepSeek由汉语版翻译成的，我进行了简单的校对。我英语水平有限，所以可能会有错误。[/color]﻿[/size]
[size=3]This mod includes both English and Chinese dialogues. The English version was translated from Chinese using DeepSeek with basic proofreading by me. My English proficiency is limited, so there might still be errors.[/size][/center][center][list=1]

[/list][/center]

Manifest.Name: Happy Life of Krobus
Manifest.Description: Allow Krobus to rest and play.
Manifest.Author: TLD_Voiland
